content.text: How to get a prescription for sildenafil.

sections.title: If you have a prescription
sections.body: You can fill it at any participating pharmacy and use the free discount card there. Prices differ between pharmacies for the same prescription, so compare before you choose.

sections.title: If you don't have one yet
sections.body: A discount card cannot replace a prescription. Community health centers see patients on a sliding scale; telehealth and urgent care are other routes.

sections.title: If the brand costs too much
sections.body: For an expensive brand-name medication, check whether the manufacturer runs an assistance program before paying cash.

card.law: Use the free FineRx card — accepted at 34+ pharmacy chains, no signup. Save it, print it, email or text it. Savings with the card can be substantial: estimated price with the card is $9.50 (observed Sep 21, 2026), more on our site. Show the card at the pharmacy to get the final price.
